lines.text: Many learners say: My bag is the same like yours.
Better: My bag is the same as yours.
As! He has the same phone as me.

data.wrong: My bag is the same like yours.
data.right: My bag is the same as yours.

quiz.stem: He has the same phone ___ me.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «مثل حقيبتك» بكلمة مثل، أما بعد the same فنستخدم as: “My bag is the same as yours.” وليس “My bag is the same like yours.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “My bag is the same like yours.” 😅 نقول بالعربية «مثل حقيبتك» بكلمة مثل، أما بعد the same فنستخدم as، فالجملة الصحيحة “My bag is the same as yours.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “as” — نقول بالعربية «مثل حقيبتك» بكلمة مثل، أما بعد the same فنستخدم as. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «مثل حقيبتك» with «مثل», but after the same we use as: “My bag is the same as yours.” not “My bag is the same like yours.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “My bag is the same like yours.” 😅 In Arabic we say «مثل حقيبتك» with «مثل», but after the same we use as, so the right sentence is “My bag is the same as yours.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
